menu.settingsTitle: General app settings (log level, log retention, meter zone colors)
menu.refreshConfigTitle: Rescan the config/ folder and refresh the channel list without restarting the app
menu.restartTitle: Stop all channels and terminate the application process

about.subtitle: Multi-channel audio logger.
restartConfirm.title: Restart application
restartConfirm.body: All channels will be stopped and the application will exit. If installed as a Windows service with automatic recovery configured, the service will restart itself; if launched via "dotnet run", it will need to be started again manually.
index.filterTitle: Show only channels whose name contains the typed text (case-insensitive).
index.emptyNoChannels: No channels configured. Add YAML configs to the config/ folder.
channelCard.playTitle: Listen to the channel in your browser (this computer's default audio output)
channelCard.outputTitle: This channel's audio file format and save location
channelEdit.nameTitle: Display name of the channel (also used in logs and statuses).
channelEdit.sourceTypeTitle: Where the audio is captured from: a network stream (Icecast/HLS) or a local sound card.
channelEdit.streamUrlTitle: Address of the audio stream (Icecast/HLS playlist).
channelEdit.streamTypeTitle: Stream format: Icecast, Icecast with MP3, or HLS (.m3u8 playlist).
channelEdit.hlsIndexTitle: If the HLS playlist has multiple audio tracks/bitrates — index of the one to use (0 — first).
channelEdit.allowHttpTitle: Allow connecting over plain HTTP if the stream doesn't support HTTPS.
channelEdit.allowInvalidSslTitle: Don't validate the server's SSL certificate (for streams with a self-signed/expired certificate).
channelEdit.metadataUrlTitle: Stream metadata mode: empty — don't collect, "icy" — Icecast's built-in ICY metadata, any other value — a discovered HLS metadata JSON endpoint. Can be entered manually or filled in with the button on the right.
channelEdit.detectButtonTitle: Detect metadata (track title) availability using the current URL/stream type settings — the result will fill the field on the left
channelEdit.deviceTitle: List of recording devices currently detected on the system. Selecting one fills in the device name and UID below.
channelEdit.refreshDevicesTitle: Refresh the device list (e.g. after plugging in a USB microphone)
channelEdit.deviceUidTitle: Unique device identifier — used for matching first and resilient to device index changes on USB reconnection.
channelEdit.deviceNameTitle: Display name of the device — filled in automatically when chosen from the list above; used for matching only if the UID isn't set.
channelEdit.savePathTitle: Disk folder or network path where this channel's audio files will be saved. Created automatically if it doesn't exist yet.
channelEdit.browseTitle: Browse a folder on the disk of the server running the Quince.Service process
channelEdit.dateFolderTitle: Subfolder name template based on the recording date, e.g. YYYY-MM-DD.
channelEdit.fileNameFormatTitle: Recording file name template, e.g. hh-mm-ss.
channelEdit.fileDurationTitle: After how many minutes the current recording file is closed and a new one started.
channelEdit.retentionTitle: After how many days this channel's old recordings are deleted automatically (0 — never delete).
channelEdit.recordAudioTitle: If off, the channel only shows level meters without saving to disk.
channelEdit.autoStartTitle: Start recording automatically when the service starts (and right after the channel is created/appears).
channelEdit.outputModeTitle: "Same as input" — output format isn't set separately; "Set below" — opens file format/bitrate/sample rate/channels settings.
channelEdit.fileFormatTitle: Format of the saved audio files.
channelEdit.sampleRateTitle: Sample rate of the output file, Hz.
channelEdit.channelsTitle: Number of channels in the output file.
channelEdit.silenceDetectorTitle: Pause the activity indication during prolonged silence in the input signal.
channelEdit.thresholdTitle: Volume level below which the signal is considered silence, dBFS.
channelEdit.triggerTitle: After how many seconds of continuous silence the detector triggers.
channelEdit.resumeTitle: After how many seconds of sound following silence the detector clears the silence flag.
channelEdit.errorNameExists: A channel with this name already exists.
channelEdit.errorSavePathRequired: Enter a save folder for recordings.
channelEdit.errorSavePathTimeout: The save folder is unavailable: timed out (the network path is not responding).
channelEdit.errorDeviceListWindows: Could not query the Windows audio subsystem (check that the "Windows Audio" service is running): {0}
channelEdit.errorDeviceListGeneric: Could not get the list of recording devices: {0}
clone.title: Clone channel?
clone.body: A new channel "{0} (copy)" will be created with the same configuration. The clone's auto-start is disabled so two engines don't run against the same source at once.
delete.title: Delete channel?
delete.body: The channel "{0}" and its config file ({1}) will be deleted permanently. Already recorded audio files are not deleted.
appSettings.title: Application settings
appSettings.reconnectDelayTitle: Pause before retrying a connection after a stream/device drop, in seconds. Applies immediately to all already-running channels.
appSettings.reconnectMaxTitle: After this many consecutive failed reconnect attempts, the channel stops and an ERROR is logged, instead of retrying forever. 0 — unlimited.
appSettings.adKeywordsTitle: Words that, if present in a track's title/artist, mark the metadata entry as class "C" (advertisement) in the CSV — case-insensitive. Comma-separated.
appSettings.newsKeywordsTitle: Words that, if present in a track's title/artist, mark the metadata entry as class "N" (news) in the CSV — case-insensitive. Comma-separated.
indicators.channelNotFound: Channel not found (it may have been deleted).
indicators.maxTitle: Peak maximum since start/last reset — click resets all maximums for the channel
readme.notFound: README.md not found next to the application.
folderBrowser.title: Select folder
folderBrowser.pathTitle: You can type a path manually and press "Go" or Enter
folderBrowser.errorNotExists: The folder doesn't exist or is unavailable.
